# Pro Grade Detailing

> Mobile car, RV and mobile home detailing based in Silver Spring, Maryland. Owner: Rob (Robert) Vernola, in business since 2021. Serves Washington DC, Montgomery and Prince George's counties in Maryland, and Northern Virginia. Rated 4.8 out of 5 across 25 Google reviews.

- Phone (call or text): (301) 888-6865
- Email: progradedetailingdmv@gmail.com
- Online booking: https://cal.callwhale.com/progradedetailing
- Fully mobile: work is done at the customer's home, office, storage lot or campground.

## Car services (starting prices; add-ons can change the final price)

- Pro Level Package (full interior and exterior detail): from $199, about 3 hours
- Interior only: from $159, about 1.5 hours
- 5-year ceramic coating: from $549, about 5 hours
- 10-year ceramic coating: from $799, about 6 hours
- Maintenance service (returning clients within a month of a full detail): from $90, about 1 hour
- Sport motorcycle detail: from $60, about 1 hour

## RV and mobile home services (priced by length, about 5 hours)

- 30 ft or less: full detail $699+, exterior only $399+, interior only $399+
- 31 to 35 ft: full detail $795+, exterior only $449+, interior only $449+
- 36 to 40 ft: full detail $895+, exterior only $499+, interior only $499+
- Over 40 ft: custom quote by phone or text
